Parent Relief / Parent Relief (Disability)

Parent Relief is given to recognise individuals who support their parents, grandparents, parents-in-law or grandparents-in-law in Singapore. You may claim $9,000 for each parent who lives with you, or $5,500 for each parent who does not live with you. If your parent has a disability, you may claim $14,000 if they live with you, or $10,000 if they do not.
To qualify, your parent must be 55 years old or above in the previous year, or have a physical or mental disability, and must not have an annual income of more than $8,000. You must have supported your parent with at least $2,000 in the previous year.

The relief can be shared between siblings who support the same parent. Claim it in your income tax return through myTax Portal.
